concerns.text: Circular producer/consumer on prs_labeled.csv. T060 requires prs_labeled.csv to contain the full pr_schema columns including complexity_score, loc, comment_count, time_to_merge_minutes, review_cycles — but those values are only computed by T061 (complexity) and T062 (metrics), both of which READ prs_labeled.csv as input. As ordered, T060 cannot produce a schema-valid file, and T061/T062 cannot run on a file lacking their join key context. Either T060 writes only label columns (and the contract is split), or T061/T062 write to a distinct intermediate file that T062 (not T060) assembles into the full-schema CSV.

T065 aggregates 'complexity_correlation read from the correlation analysis' into results.json, but no remaining task produces a correlation artifact file. T035 is marked complete yet declares no output path, and the prior verification round found all data artifacts missing — so the consumer T065 has no verifiable producer. Add a task (or extend T062/T063) that writes the correlation output to a declared path before T065.

T063 writes results.json and T065 'extends T063's output' by rewriting the same file. Two tasks writing the same artifact path in sequence is workable but fragile; state explicitly that T065 rewrites/extends data/processed/results.json (it does) and that T067 must consume only the post-T065 version — currently implied only by the dependency chain. Minor clarity nit only.
